notes:
Tidier series, smarter imports, and a friendlier sign-in.

- **Extras, for every series.** Anime, TV shows and cartoons now get an
  **Extras** tab for the OVAs, ONAs, specials, movies and credits that come
  bundled with a download — so they stop cluttering up your seasons or landing
  in a stray "Season 0". New downloads are sorted into Extras automatically, and
  you can **right-click any episode → Move to / out of Extras** to fix anything
  by hand. Extras don't count toward a show's progress or "next episode".

- **Smarter imports.** Series whose seasons live in separate folders are now
  recognised properly, and later seasons keep their episode titles and posters
  instead of coming up blank. Adding certain torrents (big multi-season batches)
  no longer fails with an "couldn't analyze that" error.

- **Clearer sign-in.** When the app can't reach the server you now get a plain,
  helpful message instead of a wall of technical text — and there's a **Forgot
  password?** link on the sign-in screen.
